text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, follows patterns and rules. It cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. So while AI can be a helpful tool for artists and writers, it cannot replace the unique spark of human creativity.
